title: EcoCard: Which Merchants and Purchases Qualify as Green?
summary: EcoCard earns $5.00 points per dollar on purchases that meet green criteria: public transportation passes/fare, electric vehicle charging, renewable energy subscriptions/providers, certified sustainable retailers/eco-labeled products, and local bike share/micromobility. Green merchant partners (~3 certified) are recognized automatically; eligibility can be verified via a green badge in the merchant directory or green indicators on receipts/statements, and edge cases exclude gift cards/cash equivalents and some marketplace/delivery or mixed-cart transactions.
faqs: Which types of purchases qualify as “green” for EcoCard points?
Do purchases at certified green merchant partners qualify automatically? How many are in the partner network?
How can I verify whether a merchant or transaction is eligible before I pay?
What do green indicators on receipts/statements mean for my purchase?
If a purchase doesn’t show as green, what should I do and what info should I provide to support?
Why might marketplace/delivery-platform or mixed-cart purchases not qualify as green? Do gift cards qualify?
